name: Atlantic City
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Atlantic City?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes, plain golf carts no. In Atlantic City, a registered electric LSV may use roads posted 25 mph or less. A town can open a road up to 35 mph by ordinance. No such ordinance was found.

golf_cart.notes: New Jersey does not register a plain golf cart for the street

lsv.notes: Electric, titled, and insured. Not on the expressway.

rules.rule: An LSV may use a public road posted 25 mph or less. A municipality may by ordinance open a road posted up to 35 mph, or ban a hazardous street.
An LSV must be electric and meet the federal low-speed vehicle standard. A gas golf cart does not qualify.

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Atlantic City?
faq.a: Roads posted 25 mph or less. Electric, titled, and insured. Not on the expressway. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Atlantic City?
faq.a: No. New Jersey allows a registered electric low-speed vehicle, not a plain golf cart.

faq.q: Can an LSV use Atlantic Avenue?
faq.a: Only where it is posted 25 mph or less. No city ordinance opening 30 or 35 mph roads was found.
